plan.title: Lab 2 still tells learners to export a private curriculum clone after the public deftai move

narratives.Description: Lab 2 still tells learners to export a private curriculum clone after the public deftai move
narratives.Overview:
## Situation

I am taking the public `deftai/directive-training` course as a mid-level engineer. The root README correctly identifies this as the public `deftai/directive-training` repository.

Lab 2, the shared lab environment guide, and the capstone lab still tell the learner to export `DIRECTIVE_TRAINING_ROOT` as the absolute path of their **private curriculum clone**:

- `labs/02-disposable-initialization.md` (required environment, value table, macOS and Windows setup)
- `labs/README.md` (fixture copy instruction)
- `labs/capstone-end-to-end.md` (Windows setup)

Closed issue #2 was “Correct repo identity after the public deftai clone.” That identity recut did not reach these learner-facing lab strings.

## Pain

I paused before Lab 2 `create` to check whether I was in the wrong clone. The lab treats `DIRECTIVE_TRAINING_ROOT` as a safety input: if it is wrong, later blocks print `Paste refusal`. Calling the public course a “private curriculum clone” makes a first-time learner second-guess the one path the helper must receive.

It also conflicts with the issue-filing instruction in the root README. A learner who is told the clone is private cannot tell whether filing a public GitHub issue is allowed.

## Proposed fix

Replace “private curriculum clone/repository” with “this curriculum clone” or “the `deftai/directive-training` checkout” in learner-facing lab text. Keep “private” only where it still describes fictional lab data or `package.json` `private: true`.

Add a one-line Lab 2 starting check: the clone may be the public GitHub repository; the helper only needs its absolute path.

OS: macOS Darwin 25.6.0 arm64  
Shell: zsh 5.9  
Directive: `@deftai/directive@0.119.5` (Lab 2 project-local)

Leave `this curriculum clone` / `this curriculum repository` on those lines, matching Lab 2 paste-refusal `curriculum clone path`.
Keep already-pinned `private` strings: Lab 7 fixture-must-remain-private, capstone private notes, fixture `package.json` `"private": true`, `labs/README.md` private chat.

Capstone Windows takes the phrase recut at `:91`. Lab 2 carries the first-lab identity sentence.

Round 1 fresh open critique of work issue 50 at SHA `19f2b3dd829d089519a22cfeaba8d0bbd7fb9e23`, input ceiling 5768895526.

## Re-verification

`git grep` at that SHA for `private curriculum clone` and `private curriculum repository` under `labs/` returns six hits, matching P1's cites:

- `labs/02-disposable-initialization.md:38` (`private curriculum repository`)
- `labs/02-disposable-initialization.md:64`, `:87`, `:149` (`private curriculum clone`)
- `labs/README.md:57`
- `labs/capstone-end-to-end.md:91`

`git show` `README.md:18-19` names the public `deftai/directive-training` repository. Lab 2 paste-refusal fences and `labs/fixtures/02-disposable-initialization/init-lab.mjs` already say `absolute curriculum clone path` and `Stop: the lab is inside the curriculum clone.` with no `private curriculum` string. `node scripts/verify-modules-2-3.mjs` exits 0: it pins Lab 2 heading `Environment and starting-state check` and root/fixture `"private": true`, and it does not pin the stale clone phrase. `scripts/verify-capstone.mjs` pins Windows `DIRECTIVE_TRAINING_ROOT` resolution and private-note paths; it does not pin `private curriculum clone`.

## 1. Recut set is the two leftover phrases at the six cites

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: P1's sentence describes those cites as still saying `private curriculum clone`. Line 38 says `private curriculum repository`. A search for only the clone form misses it. The proposed fix already writes `clone/repository`. Other `private` strings in labs are already pinned: Lab 7 `The fixture must remain private`; capstone private notes (`verify-capstone.mjs` matches `private[\s\S]{0,80}capstone-assessment-note.md` and `separate private notes directory`); fixture helpers `assert.equal(manifest.private, true)`; `labs/README.md:126` `private chat`; root `package.json` `"private": true` (`verify-modules-2-3.mjs` line 689).

Failure mode: a clone-only grep leaves Lab 2:38. A sweep of every `private` in `labs/` breaks the capstone verifier and the fixture-private assertions.

Disposition: bind the recut to those two phrases at the six P1 cites. Keep the other `private` strings. Widen the issue's keep-list (fictional lab data and `package.json` `private: true`) to include those already-pinned surfaces.

## 2. One replacement phrase

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: the proposed fix offers `this curriculum clone` or `the deftai/directive-training checkout`. Lab 2 paste-refusal and recovery already say `curriculum clone path`. Later labs already ship a different identity-neutral phrase: `labs/05-projection-drift-recovery.md:41-44` (`this curriculum repository's root`, `curriculum checkout`); `labs/10-implementation-golden-path.md:40-42, :61` (`this curriculum checkout`); capstone macOS `:51` (`curriculum checkout root`).

Failure mode: mixing the two proposed replacements across the six cites splits learner identity the same way the #2 file-list recut left these lab strings.

Disposition: the closed recut deletes `private` and leaves `this curriculum clone` / `this curriculum repository` on those lines, matching Lab 2's own paste-refusal. Unifying Lab 2 onto later-lab `curriculum checkout` is a wider vocabulary recut; record that widening on the parent take only if it is taken.

## 3. Starting check names DIRECTIVE_TRAINING_ROOT identity

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: the proposed one-liner is `the clone may be the public GitHub repository; the helper only needs its absolute path.` Lab 2:62-70 already splits `DIRECTIVE_TRAINING_ROOT` (helper location) from `LAB_ROOT` (printed attempt). Every paste block re-derives the helper from `DIRECTIVE_TRAINING_ROOT`; every verb after `create` takes `LAB_ROOT`. `init-lab.mjs:348` stops when the lab is inside the curriculum clone. Lab 2:189 requires work in the printed `LAB_ROOT`. Lab 2:70 names coding-agent hosts that start a fresh shell per block. README:73-76 requires disposable-lab work outside this repository. README:90-94 already sends defects to this repository's issue tracker.

Failure mode: `the helper only needs its absolute path` collapses the two values. A coding-agent host can point both at the public checkout and run `create` inside the curriculum tree until the helper Stop fires. The pause-before-create pain is real; the one-liner over-claims the helper contract.

Disposition: keep a Lab 2 identity sentence on the existing required-environment bullet (the :38 cite): the public `deftai/directive-training` checkout is a valid `DIRECTIVE_TRAINING_ROOT`, used only to read the fixture and run the helper. Capstone Windows takes the phrase recut at :91; Lab 2 carries the first-lab identity sentence.

Injection / swarm lens: this finding changes identity of the two exported paths and shared state (attempt root versus curriculum checkout). Existing control is the helper Stop plus Lab 2 safety. The one-liner stays a learner identity sentence for `DIRECTIVE_TRAINING_ROOT`. Dest and occupancy for the attempt remain the printed `LAB_ROOT`.

## 4. COST-ESTIMATE.md still says private curriculum repository

class: footnote

`COST-ESTIMATE.md` contains 14 `private curriculum repository` lines at this SHA. Closed issue #2 left that file out of its identity recut. Issue 50's P1 and proposed fix name lab pages. Same phrase class, outside this closed recut unless a later issue expands it.

## Road not taken

Existing mechanism: issue #2's identity recut, later labs' `curriculum checkout` wording, and Lab 2 paste-refusal already without `private`. The closed recut extends that coverage to the six leftover lines.

A new labs-wide grep gate was considered. `verify-modules-2-3.mjs` already `doesNotMatch` stale phrases on markdown and already reads `labs/02-disposable-initialization.md` and `labs/README.md`. A `doesNotMatch` there would prevent a third leftover. It is optional prevention; this recut can bind without it.

Steelman of writing `the deftai/directive-training checkout` on every cite: it matches README:18-19 and makes public identity unmistakable on the export sentence, which could carry the pause-before-create fix without a separate starting check. What would flip that: the Lab 2 value table and paste-refusal already say `curriculum clone path`, so that page would then disagree with itself. Deleting `private` and keeping clone on Lab 2 keeps that page internally consistent.
